notes: Telemetry bootstrap reliability + confirmed Roblox ErrorPrompt recovery. Start Watchdog now validates that the embedded telemetry version is actually active in the current Roblox session. If Roblox is already running but the telemetry mailbox is missing/stale or the running version does not match, Watchdog performs one bootstrap rejoin so Delta loads the current Autoexecute telemetry, then verifies the mailbox again. If telemetry still fails, status is marked degraded instead of silently assuming Instant Disconnect recovery is active. Live test confirmed Roblox ErrorPrompt detection, event capture, client shutdown and automatic rejoin.
